description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Ulalek and Writhing Chrysalis' first ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell.
Resolve the copy of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Each Writhing Chrysalis you control triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each of them.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
